CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_master_private (
    id TEXT,
    parent_id TEXT,
    scb_name TEXT,  -- Name of the state cooperative bank
    scb_registration_no TEXT,  -- Registration number of the state cooperative bank
    registration_date TEXT,  -- Registration date of the state cooperative bank
    rbi_license TEXT,  -- RBI license number of the state cooperative bank
    rbi_license_date TEXT,  -- RBI license date of the state cooperative bank
    ifsc_code TEXT,  -- IFSC code of the state cooperative bank
    registration_authority_name TEXT,
    location_urban_rural TEXT,  -- Location of the registered office of the state cooperative bank ( 1 = Urban, 2 = Rural )
    state_name TEXT,  -- State Name of the state cooperative bank
    district_name TEXT,  -- District Name of the state cooperative bank
    operation_area_location TEXT,
    is_city TEXT,  -- Flag indicating if the registered office of the state cooperative bank is in a city ( 1 = Yes, 0 = No )
    city_name TEXT,  -- Name of the city
    block_name TEXT,  -- Block Name of the bank
    gram_panchayat_name TEXT,  -- Gram Panchayat Name of the bank
    village_name TEXT,  -- Village Name of the bank
    urban_local_body_category_name TEXT,
    urban_local_body_name TEXT,
    ward_name TEXT,  -- Ward Name of the bank
    pin_code TEXT,  -- Pin Code of the bank
    full_address TEXT,  -- Full Address of the bank
    functional_status TEXT,  -- Functional Status of the bank ( 1 = Functional , 2 = Under Liquidation , 3 = Non Functional )
    number_of_member TEXT,  -- Number of members of the bank
    number_of_branches TEXT,  -- Total Number of branches of the bank
    area_of_operation_states TEXT,  -- List of the states where the bank operates (Multile entries comma seperated)
    latest_audit_year TEXT,  -- Latest audit year of the bank
    is_profit_making TEXT,  -- Whether the bank is profit making (1=Yes, 0=No)
    net_profit TEXT,  -- Net profit of the bank (in Lakhs)
    net_loss TEXT,  -- Net loss of the bank (in Lakhs)
    annual_turnover TEXT,  -- Annual turnover of the bank (in Lakhs)
    annual_income TEXT,  -- Annual income of the bank (in Lakhs)
    annual_expense TEXT,  -- Annual expense of the bank (in Lakhs)
    is_dividend_paid TEXT,  -- Whether the bank has paid dividend (1=Yes, 0=No)
    dividend_paid_rate TEXT,  -- Dividend rate of the bank (in percentage)
    total_assets TEXT,  -- Total assets of the bank (in Lakhs)
    total_liabilities TEXT,  -- Total liabilities of the bank (in Lakhs)
    office_building_type_name TEXT,  -- Type of office building of the bank
    has_office_building TEXT,  -- Whether the bank has office building (1=Yes, 0=No)
    is_scheme_implemented TEXT,  -- Whether the bank has implementing any Central or Government scheme (1=Yes, 0=No)
    dccb_bank_type_membership_name TEXT,  -- Type of membership of the bank
    dccb_bank_member TEXT,  -- Whether the bank is member of DCCB (1=Yes, 0=No)
    dccb_bank_member_count TEXT,  -- Number of DCCB memberships of the bank
    dccb_bank_is_member TEXT,  -- Id of the DCCB bank (FK) which are members of this bank (Multile entries comma seperated) used in dccb_master_private
    dccb_bank_class_membership TEXT,  -- Class of membership of the bank ( 1 = Ordinary/Regular/Voting , 2 = Associate/Nominal/Voting )
    pacs_member TEXT,  -- Whether the PACS is the member of this bank (1=Yes, 0=No)
    pacs_member_class_membership TEXT,  -- Class of membership of the bank ( 1 = Ordinary/Regular/Voting , 2 = Associate/Nominal/Voting )
    pacs_member_count TEXT,  -- Number of PACS memberships of the bank
    society_district_names TEXT,  -- List of the districts of the PACS (Multile entries comma seperated) which are members of this bank
    pacs_is_member_affiliated TEXT,  -- Id of the PACS (FK) which are members of this bank (Multile entries comma seperated)
    pacs_is_member_not_affiliated TEXT,
    other_member TEXT,  -- Whether the bank has any other members besides DCCB and PACS (1=Yes, 0=No)
    other_member_count TEXT,  -- Number of other members of the bank
    status TEXT,  -- status of the bank (1=Active, 0=Inactive)
    is_delete TEXT,  -- Is the bank is deleted or not ( 1 = Yes, 0 = No)
    is_draft TEXT,  -- Is the bank is draft or not ( 1 = Yes, 0 = No)
    is_comp TEXT,  -- Wheather the bank is computerised or not (1=Yes, 0=No)
    ncd_id TEXT  -- Main NCD ID of the bank
);

CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_contact_details ( -- This table contains the contact details of the persons associated with the banks.
    id TEXT,
    state_cooperative_bank_id TEXT,  -- Id of the state cooperative bank (FK) used in scb_master_private
    contact_person TEXT,  -- Name of the contact person
    designation_name TEXT,  -- Designation of the contact person
    phone_number TEXT,  -- Phone number of the contact person
    landline TEXT,  -- Landline number of the contact person
    email TEXT  -- Email of the contact person
);

CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_schemes_private ( -- This table contains information about the schemes implemented by the banks.
    id TEXT,
    state_cooperative_bank_id TEXT,  -- Id of the state cooperative bank (FK) used in scb_master_private
    scheme_type TEXT,  -- Type of scheme (1=Central Govt Scheme, 2=State Govt Scheme)
    govt_scheme_name TEXT,  -- Name of the scheme
    total_amount_extended TEXT  -- Total amount extended under the scheme (in Lakhs)
);

CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_area_rural_private ( -- This table contains information about the rural areas where the banks operate.
    id TEXT,
    scb_id TEXT,  -- Id of the state cooperative bank (FK) used in scb_master_private
    state_name TEXT,  -- Name of the state
    district_name TEXT,  -- Name of the District
    block_name TEXT  -- Name of the Block
);

CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_area_urban_private ( -- This table contains information about the urban areas where the banks operate.
    id TEXT,
    scb_id TEXT,  -- Id of the state cooperative bank (FK) used in scb_master_private
    state_name TEXT,  -- Name of the state
    district_name TEXT,  -- Name of the district
    localbody_type_name TEXT,  -- Type of local body
    local_body_name TEXT,  -- Name of the local body
    ward_name TEXT  -- Name of the ward
);

CREATE TABLE chatbot_scb_other_members_private ( -- This table contains information about the other members of the state cooperative banks.
    id TEXT,
    state_cooperative_bank_id TEXT,  -- Id of the state cooperative bank (FK) used in scb_master_private
    org_name TEXT,  -- Name of the other member organization
    type_membership_name TEXT,  -- Type of membership of the other member
    class_membership TEXT,  -- Class of membership of the other member (1=Ordinary/Regular/Voting, 2=Associate/Nominal/Voting)
    primary_activity_name TEXT,  -- Primary activity of the other member
    district_name TEXT,  -- Name of the district where the other member is located
    address TEXT,  -- Address of the other member
    phone_number TEXT,  -- Phone number of the other member
    email TEXT  -- Email of the other member
);

Documentation:
Data Dictionary for chatbot_scb_ master tables: scb_dcb_flag (1=SCB, 2=DCB, 3=SCARDB, 4=PCARDB); location_urban_rural (1=Urban, 2=Rural); functional_status (1=Functional, 2=Under Liquidation, 3=Non Functional); is_city/is_comp/is_dividend_paid (1=Yes, 0=No); status (1=Active, 0=Inactive); scheme_type (1=Central Govt Scheme, 2=State Govt Scheme); class_membership (1=Ordinary/Regular/Voting, 2=Associate/Nominal/Voting).

The table chatbot_scb_master_private is the master table for all state and district cooperative banks.

All other bank-related tables (contact details, schemes, areas, other members) are linked to chatbot_scb_master_private via the id column.

Contact details for bank personnel are stored in the table chatbot_scb_contact_details.

Information about various government schemes implemented by the banks is stored in chatbot_scb_schemes_private.

The name of a DCCB (District Central Cooperative Bank) should be fetched from the name column of the district_central_cooperative_bank table by mapping it to the scb_name in the master table.

When scb_dcb_flag is 4 (PCARDB), the area of operation locations are stored in chatbot_scb_area_rural_private and chatbot_scb_area_urban_private.

Audit figures like net_profit, annual_turnover, etc. are stored in lakhs.

State cooperative banks, state banks , SCBs , SCB are the same thing (State cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 1 , District cooperative bank, District banks, DCCBs, DCB are the same thing (District cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 2 , State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, SCARDBs, SCARDB are the same thing (State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 3 , Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, PCARDBs, PCARDB are the same thing (Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 4

Question:
List all State Cooperative Banks (StCB)
response: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.scb_registration_no, scb.state_name, scb.registration_date, scb.ncd_id, scb.rbi_license, scb.rbi_license_date, scb.ifsc_code FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

response: SELECT dm.name, scd.contact_person, scd.phone_number, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_dccb_master_private dm ON scb.id = dm.id JOIN chatbot_scb_contact_details scd ON scb.id = scd.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 2 AND scb.functional_status = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

The table chatbot_scb_master_private is the master table for all state and district cooperative banks.

All other bank-related tables (contact details, schemes, areas, other members) are linked to chatbot_scb_master_private via the id column.

Information about various government schemes implemented by the banks is stored in chatbot_scb_schemes_private.

The name of a DCCB (District Central Cooperative Bank) should be fetched from the name column of the district_central_cooperative_bank table by mapping it to the scb_name in the master table.

When scb_dcb_flag is 4 (PCARDB), the area of operation locations are stored in chatbot_scb_area_rural_private and chatbot_scb_area_urban_private.

Audit figures like net_profit, annual_turnover, etc. are stored in lakhs.

State cooperative banks, state banks , SCBs , SCB are the same thing (State cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 1 , District cooperative bank, District banks, DCCBs, DCB are the same thing (District cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 2 , State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, SCARDBs, SCARDB are the same thing (State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 3 , Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, PCARDBs, PCARDB are the same thing (Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 4

Question:
List all SCARDB banks with no RBI license
response: SELECT scb.scb_name, scb.state_name, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 3 AND (scb.rbi_license IS NULL OR scb.rbi_license = '') AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

response: SELECT scb.state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT scb.id) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_schemes_private s ON scb.id = s.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 4 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY scb.state_name;

response: SELECT scb.scb_name, om.org_name, om.class_membership, scb.ncd_id FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_other_members_private om ON scb.id = om.state_cooperative_bank_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND om.class_membership = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0;

The table chatbot_scb_master_private is the master table for all state and district cooperative banks.

All other bank-related tables (contact details, schemes, areas, other members) are linked to chatbot_scb_master_private via the id column.

Contact details for bank personnel are stored in the table chatbot_scb_contact_details.

Information about various government schemes implemented by the banks is stored in chatbot_scb_schemes_private.

The name of a DCCB (District Central Cooperative Bank) should be fetched from the name column of the district_central_cooperative_bank table by mapping it to the scb_name in the master table.

When scb_dcb_flag is 4 (PCARDB), the area of operation locations are stored in chatbot_scb_area_rural_private and chatbot_scb_area_urban_private.

Audit figures like net_profit, annual_turnover, etc. are stored in lakhs.

State cooperative banks, state banks , SCBs , SCB are the same thing (State cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 1 , District cooperative bank, District banks, DCCBs, DCB are the same thing (District cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 2 , State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, SCARDBs, SCARDB are the same thing (State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 3 , Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, PCARDBs, PCARDB are the same thing (Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 4

Documentation:
Data Dictionary for chatbot_scb_ master tables: scb_dcb_flag (1=SCB, 2=DCB, 3=SCARDB, 4=PCARDB); location_urban_rural (1=Urban, 2=Rural); functional_status (1=Functional, 2=Under Liquidation, 3=Non Functional); is_city/is_comp/is_dividend_paid (1=Yes, 0=No); status (1=Active, 0=Inactive); scheme_type (1=Central Govt Scheme, 2=State Govt Scheme); class_membership (1=Ordinary/Regular/Voting, 2=Associate/Nominal/Voting).

The table chatbot_scb_master_private is the master table for all state and district cooperative banks.

All other bank-related tables (contact details, schemes, areas, other members) are linked to chatbot_scb_master_private via the id column.

Contact details for bank personnel are stored in the table chatbot_scb_contact_details.

Information about various government schemes implemented by the banks is stored in chatbot_scb_schemes_private.

The name of a DCCB (District Central Cooperative Bank) should be fetched from the name column of the district_central_cooperative_bank table by mapping it to the scb_name in the master table.

When scb_dcb_flag is 4 (PCARDB), the area of operation locations are stored in chatbot_scb_area_rural_private and chatbot_scb_area_urban_private.

Audit figures like net_profit, annual_turnover, etc. are stored in lakhs.

State cooperative banks, state banks , SCBs , SCB are the same thing (State cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 1 , District cooperative bank, District banks, DCCBs, DCB are the same thing (District cooperative bank) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 2 , State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, SCARDBs, SCARDB are the same thing (State cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 3 , Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks, PCARDBs, PCARDB are the same thing (Primary cooperative agricultural and rural development banks) so use the scb_dcb_flag = 4

Question:
Count of rural blocks served by StCBs grouped by state
response: SELECT scb.state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.block_name) FROM chatbot_scb_master_private scb JOIN chatbot_scb_area_rural_private r ON scb.id = r.scb_id WHERE scb.scb_dcb_flag = 1 AND scb.status = 1 AND scb.is_delete = 0 AND scb.is_draft = 0 GROUP BY scb.state_name;
